profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc. is a publicly traded company (ticker UBER) headquartered in San Francisco, California, with SEC CIK 0001543151. On its own site, Uber describes a platform and apps that let people earn, eat, commute, get a ride, and simplify business travel. The company says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber as a key part of what it calls reimagining movement, working with industry leaders and using what it describes as a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers.

The site material does not name specific AI products, and no products are tracked for the company. Its stated autonomous vehicle effort is the main technology direction visible in the harvested text.

On the litigation side, the company's recorded exposure is concentrated in California, with 281 cases counted there. No individual cases are listed in the record.
